title: IAA Contract
description: JSON Schema for the Intent Anticipation Agent input (ProcessState) and output (ActionRecommendation).

ProcessStep.title: ProcessStep
ProcessStep.description: A single structured step from the process history, richer than a plain string.

event_type.description: The event type label that occurred at this step.

actor.description: Role label or resource ID of who performed this step.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 datetime of when this step occurred; null for steps without timing data.

outcome.description: Result of this step if known (e.g. 'approved', 'rejected').

PredictedAction.title: PredictedAction
PredictedAction.description: One candidate next action with a confidence score and reasoning.

action_id.description: Snake_case unique identifier for this predicted action (e.g. 'request_document').

label.description: Human-readable label for display to the user or orchestrator.

confidence.description: Model confidence in this action being the correct next step, between 0 and 1.

reasoning.description: Natural-language explanation of why this action was predicted.

TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: A single actionable task destined for the Delegation Agent.

action.description: Snake_case action identifier the Delegation Agent will execute.

assigned_role.description: Role label for the Delegation Agent to assign this task to.

depends_on.description: List of task_ids that must complete before this task can begin.

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this task is included in the recommendation.

WorkflowStep.title: WorkflowStep
WorkflowStep.description: One step in the chronological workflow timeline from case start to end.

step.description: Ordinal position of this step in the full workflow sequence.

event_type.description: Event type label identifying what happens at this workflow step.

actor.description: Role or resource responsible for executing this step.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this step — completed, active, or a future prediction.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 datetime for completed or current steps; null for predicted steps.

ProcessState.title: ProcessState
ProcessState.description: Current state of a process instance, assembled from its event history. Primary input to the IAA chain.

entity_id.description: Unique identifier for the case, claim, or contract being processed.

current_stage.description: The process stage the entity is currently in (e.g. 'verification', 'review').

current_event_type.description: The most recent event type that triggered this IAA invocation.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 datetime of the current event triggering this prediction.

prior_actions.description: Ordered list of event_type strings from the case history, oldest first.

prior_steps.description: Structured prior actions including actor and timestamp when available.

actor.description: Role label or resource ID of who triggered the current event.

metadata.description: Domain-specific key-value pairs (e.g. amount, priority, SLA hours).

context_summary.description: Narrative summary injected by the Context Stitching Agent if available.

risk_flags.description: List of risk flag labels raised by the Risk Radar Agent if available.

risk_severity.description: Aggregate severity level from the Risk Radar Agent.

policy_constraints.description: Active governance policy constraints from the Governance Agent if available.

assigned_owner.description: Owner already assigned by the Delegation Agent if available upstream.

operating_context.description: Indicates whether all upstream agents contributed ('full') or some were absent.

ActionRecommendation.title: ActionRecommendation
ActionRecommendation.description: Structured IAA output, always the same shape regardless of process domain. Consumed by the LangGraph orchestrator and Delegation Agent.

predicted_actions.description: Top 1–3 predicted next actions ranked by confidence score, highest first.

recommended_action.description: The single highest-confidence action to surface to the user or orchestrator.

override_applied.description: True when a hard business rule fired and overrode the LLM-generated output.

override_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of which rule fired when override_applied is True.

retrieved_context_ids.description: Vector store chunk IDs used during RAG retrieval, for audit traceability.

escalate_to_human.description: True when the IAA determines human review is required before proceeding.

operating_context.description: Pass-through of ProcessState.operating_context for audit log correlation.

model_used.description: Identifier of the LLM provider used for this invocation (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash').

timestamp.description: UTC datetime when this recommendation was generated.

task_list.description: Structured task breakdown for the Delegation Agent to consume and assign.

workflow_timeline.description: Chronological flowchart of case steps from start to predicted end.
